FX-GLOW-001.says: The settings as they start: completion 0, so nothing changes.

FX-GLOW-002.says: Completion 100: every pixel gone, and no light left.

FX-GLOW-003.says: Radial, completion 40: a hole from the centre, a white glow around its edge on the layer and inside the hole.

FX-GLOW-004.says: Doors, completion 40: two walls of light moving left and right from the centre.

FX-GLOW-005.says: Rectangular, completion 40: a growing square of light.

FX-GLOW-006.says: Rectangular, direction 30, completion 40: the square turned.

FX-GLOW-007.says: Doors, direction 90, completion 40: the walls move up and down.

FX-GLOW-008.says: Radial, completion 40, Color from Source on: the glow is the layer's own colour, and none over the transparent columns.

FX-GLOW-009.says: Radial, completion 40, colour #ff8000, intensity 250: a strong orange glow.

FX-GLOW-010.says: Radial, completion 40, intensity 0: the hole alone, no light.

FX-GLOW-011.says: Radial, completion 40, reversed: the wipe from the outside in, the middle kept.

FX-GLOW-012.says: Radial, Center [25, 30], completion 30: the hole moved up and to the left.

FX-GLOW-013.says: Completion keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 2 is completion 50, frame 4 all clear.

FX-GLOW-014.says: Intensity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 400 at frame 4, linear, completion 40: frame 2 is intensity 200.

FX-GLOW-015.says: FX-GLOW-003 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-GLOW-016.says: Doors, direction -135, reversed, Color from Source on, Center [60, 40], completion 55.

FX-GLOW-017.says: Completion 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-018.says: Completion -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-019.says: Center y -1001, below -1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-020.says: Intensity -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-021.says: Intensity 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-022.says: Direction 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-023.says: Shape "Radial": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-024.says: Shape "round": not a shape of Glow Wipe. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-025.says: Color from Source "yes": it is "off" or "on". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-026.says: Color "#ff80": not six hex digits. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-027.says: Reverse "true": it is "off" or "on". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-028.says: Intensity keyed to 2000 at frame 4: a key outside the range. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
